1965 · Civil rights · Assassination

Malcolm X

After leaving the Nation of Islam, Malcolm X was reshaping his politics, internationalising civil-rights claims, and preparing to expose internal and external power structures. His death fragmented emerging alliances and froze an evolving international political programme.

1965 · Journalist · Kennedy investigation

Dorothy Kilgallen

Kilgallen had interviewed Jack Ruby, criticised the Warren Commission, and told associates she possessed new information about the Kennedy assassination. Her unpublished Kennedy research became a recurring symbol of lost investigative evidence.

Baseline dossier published; continuing evidence review
